external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Eastern Elevator is a part of American Elevator Group (AEG), a rapidly growing organization of companies which furnish and install totally non-proprietary elevator equipment.

Our technicians are required to earn their CET (Certified Elevator Technician) credentials, and will receive ongoing training from NAEC (National Association of Elevator Contractors), and other accredited organizations. Our apprenticeship program allows technicians to earn while they learn the skills necessary for this exciting and in-demand career.
